verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog's documented access control is enforced on every table query, and the docs cover creating a table and granting privileges, so table-level role grants are covered. Nothing in the pack documents row filters, column-level permissions, or masking policies. A hands-on PoC report (from an older thread) found security was table-level only and contrasted this with Snowflake's row/column security and masking. missing for 10: documented row-level filtering, column-level access control, dynamic masking policies, and independent confirmation of fine-grained governance for multi-team warehouses.
